//! Fixture holding one of every comment shape Zig writes. It is stored as
//! .zig.txt so that neither cargo nor zig build picks it up.

const std = @import("std");

/// Looks the user up in the cache.
/// Falls back to the database on a miss.
///
/// ```zig
/// const user = try find(42);
///
/// // Seed the cache first.
/// _ = user;
/// ```
pub fn find(id: u64) !u64 {
    // The // in the URL below is not a comment. It sits inside a string
    // literal, and Tree-sitter leaves it there.
    const endpoint = "https://example.com/users"; // Trailing note.
    const banner =
        \\// Not a comment either: a line of a multiline string.
    ;

    ////////////////

    //// Four slashes make a plain comment, not a doc comment.

    // zig fmt: off
    const table = [_]u8{ 1,  2,
                         3,  4 };
    // zig fmt: on
    _ = .{ endpoint, banner, table };
    return id;
}

pub const User = struct {
    /// The name shown in the UI.
    name: []const u8,
};

// 日本語のコメントもそのまま抜き出す。
test find {
    _ = try find(1);
}
